project_type: React SPA with Konva canvas-based designer/consultant UI, backed by Supabase PostgreSQL
build_system: Vite + npm (no build tooling quirks); Makefile wraps frontend commands
test_framework: Vitest with @testing-library/react, jsdom environment, tests in __tests__/ dirs
build_command: cd /projects/sandbox/Bom/frontend && unset NODE_OPTIONS && npx tsc --noEmit && npx vite build
test_command: cd /projects/sandbox/Bom/frontend && unset NODE_OPTIONS && npx vitest run
verification_instructions: 1. Run typecheck: cd frontend && unset NODE_OPTIONS && npx tsc --noEmit. 2. Run tests: unset NODE_OPTIONS && npx vitest run. 3. All 814+ tests must pass.
environment_constraints: COMMON_DEPENDENCIES network. Must use `unset NODE_OPTIONS` before running node commands due to a missing proxy-bootstrap.js. Docker daemon likely unavailable.
contribution_requirements: Commit and push to feat/db-baseline-v1.1.5 branch. All existing tests must continue to pass.
key_patterns: Zustand stores (canvasStore, projectStore, bomStore). Canvas layers are react-konva components in canvas/layers/. Interactions are custom hooks in canvas/interactions/. All spatial values in integer mm with bottom-left origin. Konva renders top-left origin so layers do wallHeight - y_mm - height_mm. History is a module-level singleton with push/undo/redo. Zone constraints in canvas/utils/zoneConstraints.ts. usePermissionEnforcement guards CONSULTANT actions. SelectionState currently has selectedZoneId (singular). Template has wall_geometry JSONB and base_width_mm/base_height_mm. DB template_zone has segment TEXT nullable (SEGMENT_A/SEGMENT_B). BOM lines have source_zone_id linking back to zones.
directory_structure: frontend/src/canvas/ (CanvasContainer, layers/, interactions/, history/, permissions/, utils/, __tests__). frontend/src/stores/ (zustand stores). frontend/src/types/ (canvas.ts, database.ts). frontend/src/components/ (UI panels, toolbar). frontend/src/lib/ (coordinates, supabase client, autosave). frontend/src/engines/ (BOM calculation engines).
